The '''Jaloria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as the [[Jalorian Sodality]].<ref name="Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Jalorian Sodality]]|system=Jaloria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jaloria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-7.<ref name="TEA" />
